notes: Nemotron-3-Nano-4B_int8.litertlm as on the main branch of litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-4B since 2026-10-14 (file commit b4200576): a metadata-only re-pack of the previous file (sha256 feefdcd5...). The previous chat template rendered an assistant turn by its position (the latest one with its full think block, earlier ones as `<think></think>`), so on litert-lm 0.18.0, which hands the template each reply's reasoning_content, a second message with thinking on failed the Conversation's prefix check (`INTERNAL: The new rendered template string does not start with the previous rendered template string`; LiteRT-LM#3166 describes the check). The new template renders every assistant history turn as `<think></think>` plus the answer, the form the previous one used once a newer user turn followed; the TFLite, tokenizer and executor-metadata sections are byte-identical to the previous file, the container header is 1.7.0 (written by the 0.18 builder). These rows are function gates (three messages in one Conversation per thinking mode), not throughput measurements; per-turn elapsed times and token counts sit in metrics. The previous file was not run on this phone; on the Mac the same driver source (built from the same tag) failed the previous file at turn 2 with thinking on and default, passed it with thinking off, and gave this file the same nine turns as here (content, thought length, token counts) apart from elapsed times. The driver's VmHWM samples (every 15 s) peaked at 5148184 kB; /proc/uptime rose before and after every run (no reboot).
quantization: dynamic int8 (linears + embedding; convolutions and the selective scan stay float), fp32 activations declared, reduced 7-signature prefill ladder
